summary: Iteration 10 — verified the 3 UX/bug fixes (antimeridian crash, duplicate counters, conditional SIA blocks) + regressions. Backend: 14/14 read-only pytest checks pass (/api/route 72 features & no out-of-bounds coords with antimeridian_part 1/2; /api/zee/crossings total=117, unique_territories=13, Fijian EEZ crossing order #78 between Wallis #76 and New Caledonia #80 with territory_code null; /api/formalities 13 territories; /api/anchorages 2604 features == /api/anchorages/count.total; /api/marinas, /api/swarm/status, /api/stats 200, no _id leaks). Frontend: NO RangeError/pageerror after 3 consecutive clicks + openPopup on the easternmost Formalities marker (Nouméa lon 166.4572) at zoom 7 plus pans across the antimeridian (179 / -179 / 166) and a sidebar Nouméa flyTo — crash reproduced by the user is gone. Sidebar headers show no counters (Formalities / Marinas / Projects), Audit mode card has no repeated mode header, LIVE SWARM CONSOLE / EXTRACTION TELEMETRY / FAILED EXTRACTIONS absent from DOM with swarm idle while the 3 KPIs (kpi-total-extractions/kpi-success-rate/kpi-projects-mapped) and the Deploy button remain. Regressions OK: anchorages-toggle works (⚓ 2604, 2604 markers on map, layer state persisted), anchorage + marina + escale popups open (autoPan preserved), zee-section lists 117 crossings, FR/EN switch works. World-zoom screenshot shows no parasite vertical line at the map's left edge.
critical_code_review_comments: Anchorage/marina points are rendered as SVG CircleMarkers (path.leaflet-interactive) without data-testid, so automated marker clicks require geometric bounding-box heuristics. Consider adding a per-marker data-testid (e.g. via a DivIcon or L.CircleMarker options + custom pane attribute) to make map assertions robust.
GET /api/anchorages returns the full 2604-feature FeatureCollection with no pagination/limit param (hard-capped to_list(20000)); acceptable today but will not scale if the OSM build grows.
seed_data_creation: None — read-only navigation, no POST to build/compute endpoints (live Overpass builds untouched, no files written under /app/backend).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New read-only suite: /app/tests/test_iteration10_route_zee.py (route antimeridian split, ZEE crossings summary + Fiji leg, anchorages/formalities counts). API shapes to remember: /api/formalities -> {count, items[13]}; /api/anchorages -> GeoJSON FeatureCollection (use /api/anchorages/count for total); ZEE crossing objects use keys geoname/territory_code/seg_from/seg_to/order (no zee_name). window.__biDebug exposes {map, projects, marinas, anchorages, formalities}. Anchorage markers are SVG circles, click via path.leaflet-interactive with bounding-box filter (only ~2 .leaflet-marker-icon exist).
rca_of_the_issue: Original crash root cause (popup keepInView + maxBounds ±180 pan loop, amplified by a route segment with longitudes < -180) is fixed on both sides: keepInView removed from the 5 bindPopup calls and route.geojson split at ±180 (72 features, all coords within bounds). Verified by pageerror capture across 3 marker clicks and antimeridian pans — zero errors.
